description: Spec 003 research R20, capacity scan (side experiment, user 2026-10-14): three instantaneous LSTMs from scratch at a fixed 30-epoch budget on the iteration-2 data, loss weights 1: 96 units (the G1/G2 architecture), 192 units, and two stacked 128-unit layers. Validation only, reported by tma-scan beside naive and classical; never a gate decision. Informs whether capacity moves the speed error before any iteration commits to a larger model.
